title: Best of Quebec City: Panoramic Bus Tour with Local Guide
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience the highlights of Quebec City on a sightseeing tour with a friendly, knowledgeable guide. Soak up the French charm of Old Quebec and be enchanted by the old-world atmosphere and stunning beauty of sites such as Place Royal, the Plains of Abraham and Place d'Armes. During your 2-hour coach tour, you'll be shown numerous historical treasures on the banks of the St Lawrence River, giving you a great overview of this amazing city.
